incidents.title: Agent policy authority diverged across repository and runtime rule sources
incidents.observation: A permissive top-level contract coexisted with stale approval and stop gates in operator guidance, runtime memory, help text, and the machine-readable device guide, so a refreshed session could behave differently from an older session.

rootCause.summary: Multiple independently loaded authority sources were not governed by one regression-enforced current-request contract.

resolution.summary: Aligned repository and runtime authority sources, made current-request and compatibility fallback explicit, and added policy regressions that reject reintroduced approval and universal stop gates.

artifacts.claim: Defines the current user request as task authority without a second approval gate.
Defines the permanent permissive runtime contract.
Routes requested state changes and missing capabilities without universal human gates.
Rejects stale approval and universal stop contracts across tracked sources.

tests.name: rejects reintroduced approval and universal stop gates
current request authority and compatibility fallback do not become approval gates
help completes without spawning a child process
